name: Ammann Bars
desc: The hidden decoration of a quasicrystal laid bare — five families of heavy engraved bars whose gaps follow the Fibonacci musical sequence LSLLSLSLL, struck dark and confident across a toned board, crossing into a pentagrid whose cells shade into a six-tone aperiodic mosaic while a raking light wanders the plate and occasional phason flips jump a single bar by phi.

energy.doc: band contrast + bar weight + how deep the chiaroscuro bites (master knob)

scale.doc: grid unit vs frame (2.4 = a handful of huge bars, 0.6 = a dense thicket)

density.doc: how many of the bar families carry L/S band tone, and how deep the mosaic step goes

fold.doc: number of bar families — 5 is the Penrose/Ammann pentagrid; rounded to the nearest odd (3/5/7/9)

bars.doc: bar line weight — 0 is a bare tone mosaic, 1 is heavy strapwork; even 0 keeps a legible engraved rule

phason.doc: rate of discrete Fibonacci flips (single bars jumping by phi)

x.doc: arrangement centre x as canvas fraction

y.doc: arrangement centre y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: sepia copperplate engraving / cyan schematic on prussian / gilt-on-lapis Islamic / luminous additive x-ray filaments (non-representational) / dusty chalk on slate

seed.doc: phase offsets of the five Fibonacci chains + plate grain
